$comment: The icons contract. This file is data, not a JSON Schema meta-schema: it states the shape the consumer relies on and the placeholder vocabulary rules, so a mapping entry and a template can be checked against a written contract instead of against a renderer's behaviour. `schema_major` is the consumer-compatibility version (spine AD-12) and moves independently of the repo tag; raising it requires a MAJOR tag.

paths.note: Both paths are repo-local and relative to this repository's root. This file names no deployment path and no consumer destination (spine AD-2/AD-6).

shape.description: One mapping file per icon group, plus `defaults.yaml` carrying the group-independent COLOR_* vocabulary. A group is a DIRECTORY under `templates_root`; its mapping file declares `color_mappings` (the group's token values) and `variants` (the renditions a consumer may ask for).

group_entry.id: string — the group directory name under `templates_root`
group_entry.template_dir: string — subdirectory of `templates_root` holding this group's SVGs; defaults to "." when absent
group_entry.color_mappings: object — COLOR_NAME -> value (a literal color, or a scheme role the consumer resolves before rendering)
group_entry.variants: array — at least one; see variant_entry

variant_entry.name: string — unique within the group; the selector a consumer asks for
variant_entry.template: string — path to the SVG RELATIVE TO THE TEMPLATES ROOT, e.g. `mygroup/base.svg`. The consumer joins it under `templates_root`, not under the mapping file's directory and not under `template_dir`
variant_entry.output: string — the rendered file name the consumer writes; a bare file name (no path separators, no `..`)

placeholder_vocabulary.description: Placeholders are the only variable part of a template. The vocabulary is a contract: renaming a token breaks every consumer that supplies it, so a rename is a MAJOR change even though no file moved.
placeholder_vocabulary.syntax: {{COLOR_NAME}} — exactly two opening braces, the name, two closing braces, no whitespace inside, nothing else on the token
rules: Every token used by any .svg under a group's template directory MUST be declared in that group's `color_mappings`, or in `icons/mappings/defaults.yaml` (the group-independent vocabulary).
Declaring a token no SVG uses is allowed (forward compatibility); `make validate-icons` reports it, it does not fail the tag.
No defaults, filters, conditionals or nesting inside a token: `{{COLOR_BG|#000}}`, `{{ COLOR_BG }}` and `{{{{...}}}}` are invalid.

A token is substituted by the CONSUMER at render time. No rendered SVG, no generated icon index and no palette state is ever committed here (spine AD-11), so a preview of this corpus lives in the consumer, not in this repository.
`output` values and mapping keys may not contain `{{`: a placeholder in a destination is not renderable by any consumer.

validation.today: The envelope is checked by `make validate`: valid JSON, integer `schema_major`, and the `shape` / `placeholder_vocabulary` sections present. The checks in `planned` need the corpus, so they land with it.

make validate-icons: every `template:` in every mapping resolves to a real file under `icons/templates`
every `{{COLOR_*}}` token used by any SVG is declared in `defaults.yaml` or the group's `color_mappings`
every `variant.name` is unique within its group
every `output` is a bare file name
planned.arrives_with: the icons + content slice (v0.2.0): the 12 groups / 117 SVGs and the 8 mapping files that make these checks non-vacuous

validation.new_work: No schema file existed anywhere in the dotfiles corpus before this repository. The shape above is written from what the consumer's loader already expects; it is a stated contract, not a measurement of shipped data. `status: skeleton` records exactly that.
